d: U.S. special envoy Jared Kushner has issued a blunt warning that Israel is trending toward "global-pariah status" over its handling of the Gaza conflict, urging Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu to change course and back Washington’s stalled post-war peace framework. In an interview published by New York Magazine on November 23, Kushner-a key architect of both the 2020 Abraham Accords and last year’s Gaza ceasefire-argued that Israel stands at a critical fork in the road and could emerge from the October 7 tragedy far more secure and regionally integrated if its leadership embraced the…
